adjusted_prescription: The demonstrations provided show successful navigation strategies along edges and through central areas close to fire hazards, but none explicitly illustrate safe travel along the top-edge corridor as required. To address this, a clear example should be created starting near the top-left part of the layout, moving right along the top row to avoid central fire zones blocking the direct path. It is important that the agent then safely descends from the top row toward the goal column without encountering fire. This top-edge corridor demonstration will help the agent learn how to effectively avoid fires when central blocks force detours, reinforcing a reliable path-planning approach adaptable to different start points, goals, and fire placements. Incorporating this demonstration will improve the agent’s ability to generalize fire-avoidant strategies in layouts with blockages near the center.
